description: This Java class defines a REST controller for authentication endpoints, including user registration, login, and fetching current user info, using Spring Boot annotations and security features.

classes.name: AuthController
classes.description: REST controller exposing authentication endpoints for user registration, login, and current user info.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Handles user registration, creates a new user, and returns a JWT token.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Handles user login and returns a JWT token upon successful authentication.

methods.name: me
methods.description: Returns information about the currently authenticated user, or appropriate error if not authenticated.
